title: Burnt plastic smell when heating
text: Burnt plastic smell when heating. I purchased this kettle because the part that holds the water touches no plastic.  Unfortunately, for the last several weeks both my husband and I have noticed a burnt plastic smell every time we boil water. It has been getting stronger and more noticeable over the past several weeks.  I bought it about 5 months ago and was expecting it to last longer.  Very disappointing!  The return window has passed, so it's too late to return it.
